brief: 新冠住院患者三个月内总体症状减少，但症状变化与生活质量变化的相关性经多重比较校正后不显著。
Symptoms generally declined after COVID-19 hospitalization, but changes in symptoms and quality of life were not significantly correlated after multiple-testing correction.

highlights.label: Design
text: 单中心前瞻性观察，比较急性期与三个月随访。
Single-centre prospective observation comparing acute illness with three-month follow-up.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 症状负担总体下降，部分患者仍出现持续或新增症状。
Overall symptom burden fell, while some patients had persistent or newly reported symptoms.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 样本较小且无干预随机化，不能据此判断康复治疗效果。
The small, non-randomized cohort cannot establish treatment or rehabilitation efficacy.

brief: BOOST研究将评估COVID-19后高风险退伍军人的居家远程运动康复。
BOOST will evaluate home exercise telerehabilitation for high-risk veterans after COVID-19.

highlights.label: Design
text: 临床试验设计与方法报告。
Clinical trial design and methods report.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 拟观察心肺功能、体能与康复相关结局；摘要未报告治疗结果。
Planned outcomes include cardiopulmonary function, physical performance and recovery; no treatment results are reported.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 方案不能证明干预有效，结果仍需等待正式研究报告。
A protocol cannot establish efficacy; outcome reporting is still needed.

brief: 马萨诸塞州监测提示，新冠传播与年龄及场所有明显关联。
Massachusetts surveillance found age- and setting-related patterns in COVID-19 transmission.

highlights.label: Design
text: 结合逾八万五千份基因组与流行病学资料。
Linked over 85,000 genomes to epidemiological records.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 学校、大学和护理机构内的风险集中于特定年龄群体。
Risk clustered in particular age groups within schools, colleges and nursing facilities.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单州观察资料不能证明疫苗与传播关联的因果性。
Single-state observational data cannot establish causal vaccine effects on transmission.

brief: 雾化干扰素的汇总试验提示住院风险下降，但死亡获益未得到确认。
Pooled trials suggest fewer admissions with nebulized interferon, without established mortality benefit.

highlights.label: Design
text: 4项随机试验，1055人。
Four randomized trials involving 1,055 participants.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 住院和严重不良事件减少；死亡及28天恢复无显著差异。
Admissions and serious adverse events declined; mortality and day-28 recovery did not differ significantly.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 住院结局仅来自2项试验，仍需更大及当代人群研究。
Admission data came from only two trials; larger studies in contemporary populations remain needed.

brief: FDA警告信分析发现，虚假COVID-19产品宣传主要面向消费者，部分企业仍未纠正。
An FDA warning-letter analysis found consumer-directed false COVID-19 claims and incomplete subsequent compliance.

highlights.label: Design
text: 对公开监管警告信进行内容分析。
Content analysis of public regulatory warning letters.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 网站与社交媒体共同传播未经证实的宣传，说明监管与公众辨识能力均重要。
Websites and social media spread unsupported claims, highlighting enforcement and public information literacy.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 被执法样本不能衡量全部网络虚假信息或其实际健康损害。
Enforcement-selected records cannot measure all online misinformation or its health effects.

brief: 低估邻里接种意愿与自身新冠疫苗犹豫相关。
Underestimating neighbours’ vaccine willingness was associated with personal COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy.

highlights.label: Design
text: 乌干达八村1561名成人问卷调查。
Survey of 1,561 adults across eight Ugandan villages.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 误认为多数邻居不愿接种者，自身接种意愿较低。
People who wrongly perceived widespread reluctance were less willing to vaccinate.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 意愿不等于实际接种；调查不能证明改变观念会增加接种。
Intentions are not uptake; the survey cannot prove that correcting perceptions increases vaccination.

brief: COVID-19呼吸衰竭与持续炎症升高有关。
Persistent inflammation was associated with respiratory failure in COVID-19.

highlights.label: Design
text: SAVE-MORE试验587人的纵向蛋白组二次分析，并用独立队列验证。
Longitudinal proteomic secondary analysis of 587 SAVE-MORE participants with independent cohort validation.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 呼吸衰竭伴炎症升高；阿那白滞素分配与较小的炎症变化有关。
Respiratory failure accompanied inflammatory increases; anakinra allocation was associated with smaller changes.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 生物标志物关联不能独立证明具体分子的致病作用。
Biomarker associations do not independently establish causal roles for individual molecules.

brief: 全球疾病负担分析描述痴呆负担上升及人群差异，并提出模型预测。
A global burden analysis describes rising dementia burden, population differences and modelled projections.

highlights.label: Design
text: 使用GBD资料的生态趋势与预测研究。
Ecological trend and projection study using GBD data.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 作者强调年龄、性别和社会经济差异对应的预防需求。
The authors highlight prevention needs associated with age, sex and socioeconomic differences.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 疫情前后变化不能证明个体COVID-19感染导致痴呆；摘要结果有缺漏，预测依赖模型假设。
Before–after trends do not prove that individual COVID-19 infection causes dementia; incomplete abstract reporting and model assumptions limit inference.

brief: 这篇综述比较流感与冠状病毒的公共卫生挑战，强调治疗耐药与持久预防仍是共同问题。
This review compares public-health challenges from influenza and coronaviruses, emphasizing drug resistance and durable prevention.

highlights.label: Design
text: 比较性综述，涵盖流行病学、现有药物与疫苗。
Comparative review of epidemiology, available medicines and vaccines.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 作者主张把治疗研发、疫苗与监测结合起来进行防疫准备。
The authors argue for coordinated treatment, vaccination and surveillance preparedness.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 综述提出的方向不等于新产品已获批准或已证明临床获益。
Proposed priorities do not establish approval or clinical benefit for a new product.

brief: 流感接种与较少的主观认知下降相关，但不证明其预防痴呆。
Influenza vaccination correlated with less subjective cognitive decline, without establishing dementia prevention.

highlights.label: Design
text: 分析5729名美国老年人的横断面调查。
Cross-sectional analysis of 5,729 older US adults.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 调整协变量后，接种者报告认知下降的比值较低。
Vaccinated respondents had lower adjusted odds of reported cognitive decline.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 自报资料和横断面设计限制因果推断。
Self-report and cross-sectional design limit causal inference.

brief: 伊拉克哨点资料显示流感呈冬季高峰，严重呼吸道疾病与年龄和合并症相关。
Iraqi sentinel data show winter influenza peaks and associations of severe respiratory illness with age and comorbidity.

highlights.label: Design
text: 多个哨点的横断面监测资料分析。
Cross-sectional analysis of multiple sentinel sites.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 流感亚型优势随时间变化，支持持续监测及季节性预防规划。
Subtype predominance changed over time, supporting continued monitoring and seasonal prevention planning.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 哨点就诊人群不能直接代表全国感染率，相关因素不等同于因果。
Sentinel attendees do not directly represent national incidence, and associations are not causal.

brief: 儿童流感的季节分布在疫情期间改变，且可造成显著住院负担。
Paediatric influenza seasonality changed during the pandemic and caused substantial hospital burden.

highlights.label: Design
text: 回顾单家儿童医院连续十一季的3105例病例。
Reviewed 3,105 cases across eleven seasons at one paediatric hospital.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 部分亚型分析中H1N1与较高住院和并发症频率相关。
Restricted subtype analyses linked H1N1 with more hospitalizations and complications.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 医院就诊病例不能代表全部社区感染。
Hospital-presenting cases do not represent all community infections.

brief: 流感疫苗选择受到效力、安全性和价格共同影响。
Influenza vaccine choice reflected efficacy, safety, and price.

highlights.label: Design
text: 德黑兰226名成人参与离散选择实验。
A discrete-choice experiment involving 226 adults in Tehran.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 较高效力更受欢迎，严重副作用风险和价格升高降低选择概率。
Higher efficacy increased preference; serious adverse-event risk and price reduced it.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 假设选择及单地区样本不等同于实际接种行为。
Hypothetical choices in one region may not represent actual uptake.

brief: 大学宿舍试验的新统计分析为鼓励有症状者减少接触降低流感样疾病提供中等证据。
A new analysis of a college trial provides moderate evidence that encouraging symptomatic distancing reduces influenza-like illness.

highlights.label: Design
text: 整群随机试验资料结合考虑个体依赖及溢出效应的统计方法。
Cluster-randomised trial data analysed with methods accounting for dependence and spillover.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 分析提示干预可能降低流感样疾病发生。
The analysis suggests a possible reduction in influenza-like illness.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单校园与综合症终点限制推广，不能等同于实验室确诊流感的普遍效力。
A single campus and syndromic outcome limit generalisation to confirmed influenza.

brief: 常见人口和健康因素未能充分解释加拿大移民老年人的疫苗覆盖差距。
Common demographic and health factors did not adequately explain vaccination gaps among older Canadian immigrants.

highlights.label: Design
text: 对老龄化队列的两类疫苗覆盖进行差异分解。
Decomposed coverage differences for two vaccines in an ageing cohort.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 模型提示未测量的社会和结构因素值得研究。
Results motivate studying unmeasured social and structural influences.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 统计分解不能识别具体未测量因素或因果机制。
Statistical decomposition cannot identify particular unmeasured factors or causal mechanisms.

brief: 孕期RSV疫苗的接受与接种存在社会经济差异，提示实施项目需要关注获得服务的障碍。
Maternal RSV vaccine acceptance and uptake vary with socioeconomic circumstances, highlighting barriers to access.

highlights.label: Design
text: 系统综述和荟萃分析，纳入孕妇接种意愿与实际接种的观察研究。
Systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies of vaccination intention and uptake in pregnancy.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 较低教育程度和失业与较低接种意愿相关；不同群体的实际接种也有差异。
Lower education and unemployment were associated with lower intention, and uptake differed across population groups.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 群体关联不能解释为生物学差异或个人行为原因；研究并非疫苗效力试验。
Group associations are not biological explanations or individual causal accounts; this was not a vaccine-efficacy trial.

brief: 儿科医院RSV主动监测具有可行性信号。
Pediatric hospital RSV surveillance showed feasibility signals.

highlights.label: Design
text: 单中心跨4年回顾及前瞻监测。
Single-center retrospective and prospective surveillance across four years.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 识别79例院内感染；多数监测周筛查耗时不足15分钟。
Seventy-nine healthcare-associated cases were identified; screening usually took under 15 minutes weekly.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单中心试点不能证明监测本身减少感染。
A single-center pilot cannot establish that surveillance itself reduces infections.

brief: RSV疫苗经济学综述支持老年人接种可能具成本效益，但孕期接种经济证据尚不确定。
An RSV economic review suggests possible cost-effectiveness in older adults, with inconclusive maternal-vaccination evidence.

highlights.label: Design
text: 成本效益研究系统综述与荟萃分析。
Systematic review and meta-analysis of cost-effectiveness studies.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 老年人结果较稳健，婴儿获益相关估计对研究选择更敏感。
Older-adult results were more robust; infant-related estimates were more sensitive to study selection.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 研究异质性高，经济阈值、价格与当地流行情况会改变结论。
High heterogeneity, thresholds, prices and local epidemiology affect conclusions.

A bovine RSV model linked vaccination status with metabolic and inflammatory changes.

highlights.label: Design
text: 22只新生牛的多组学观察，部分分析使用更小子样本。
Multi-omics observations in 22 neonatal calves, with smaller subgroups for some analyses.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 未接种组的全身代谢与炎症变化更明显。
Unvaccinated animals showed more pronounced systemic metabolic and inflammatory changes.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 小型动物研究不能直接预测人类婴儿的治疗应答。
A small animal study cannot directly predict treatment responses in human infants.

brief: 日本医保资料显示，老年人RSV就诊后短期医疗使用和费用增加。
Japanese claims data show increased short-term healthcare use and costs after medically attended RSV in older adults.

highlights.label: Design
text: 两个行政数据库的回顾性队列研究。
Retrospective cohort using two administrative databases.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 感染后医疗资源负担上升，为预防策略提供背景。
Post-diagnosis resource burden increased, providing context for prevention strategies.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 样本较少且限于被记录的就诊病例，不能推算所有社区感染的负担。
Few recorded cases and healthcare-based ascertainment limit extrapolation to all community infections.

Adult RSV vaccine guidance broadly prioritizes older and high-risk people, with differing eligibility criteria.

highlights.label: Design

Review of multinational and professional recommendations through November 2025.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 年龄门槛、风险资格及实施条件存在明显差异。
Age thresholds, risk eligibility, and implementation conditions varied substantially.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 属于指南综述，不能替代现行本地接种建议。
This guidance review does not replace current local recommendations.

brief: 老年人二期试验中，研究性RSV/hMPV联合疫苗产生了针对两种病毒的抗体反应，仍需临床保护效果验证。
An investigational RSV/hMPV combination vaccine elicited antibody responses to both viruses in an older-adult phase 2 trial; clinical protection remains to be established.

highlights.label: Design
text: 随机比较联合候选疫苗与已上市RSV疫苗，观察安全性和免疫原性。
Randomized comparison against a licensed RSV vaccine, assessing safety and immunogenicity.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 候选疫苗产生了hMPV与RSV抗体反应，支持进一步临床研究。
Responses to hMPV and RSV supported further clinical evaluation.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 抗体反应不等于预防感染或重症；研究规模有限，候选产品仍在研究中。
Antibody responses do not establish prevention of infection or severe disease; the trial was limited in size and the candidate remains investigational.

brief: 日本成人hMPV队列发现，炎症指标升高和异常听诊与影像学肺炎相关。
A Japanese adult hMPV cohort linked inflammatory markers and abnormal auscultation with radiographic pneumonia.

highlights.label: Design
text: 单中心回顾性观察队列。
Single-centre retrospective observational cohort.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 住院者肺炎比例较高，临床体征可能辅助识别需进一步评估者。
Pneumonia was more common in admitted patients; clinical signs may help identify people needing further assessment.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 检测与影像检查选择会影响结果，不能作为已外部验证的预测工具。
Testing and imaging selection affect estimates; this is not an externally validated prediction tool.

brief: 汇总研究提示人偏肺病毒可造成重症，但风险随就诊人群变化。
Pooled studies show substantial severe HMPV disease, with risk varying by clinical population.

highlights.label: Design
text: 纳入94项观察研究的系统综述和荟萃分析。
Systematic review and meta-analysis of 94 observational studies.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 汇总住院内死亡比例约3%，成人较高。
Pooled in-hospital mortality was approximately 3%, higher among adults.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 异质性及医疗场景选择使结果不能视为所有感染者的风险。
Heterogeneity and healthcare selection preclude treating these estimates as risk for every infection.

brief: RSV与人偏肺病毒均有严重心脏并发症报告。
Severe cardiac complications have been reported with both RSV and human metapneumovirus.

highlights.label: Design
text: 系统汇总102例已发表心脏受累病例。
Systematic pooling of 102 published cases with cardiac involvement.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 心肌炎是主要报告表现，两种感染的临床特征高度重叠。
Myocarditis predominated among reports, with substantial clinical overlap.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 病例发表偏倚和宽置信区间限制比较，无法估计发生率。
Publication bias and wide intervals limit comparisons and prevent incidence estimation.

brief: 天津儿童人偏肺病毒监测呈现季节及年龄差异。
Paediatric HMPV surveillance in Tianjin showed seasonal and age-related differences.

highlights.label: Design
text: 回顾2012至2024年的儿科监测资料。
Retrospective review of paediatric surveillance from 2012 to 2024.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 优势型别随时间更替。
Predominant viral types changed over time.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单城市资料不能直接外推全国流行情况。
Single-city data do not directly establish national patterns.

brief: 人偏肺病毒在高风险人群的严重疾病负担可能被低估。
Severe human metapneumovirus burden may be underrecognized in high-risk groups.

highlights.label: Design
text: 综述流行病学、诊疗及预防研究。
Review of epidemiology, clinical care, and prevention research.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 检测不足和症状重叠妨碍识别，强调诊断与感染预防。
Undertesting and overlapping symptoms hinder recognition, supporting better diagnosis and infection prevention.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 综述中的治疗和疫苗状态仅反映其资料时间。
Treatment and vaccine status reflect the review’s evidence period.

brief: 儿童队列比较显示，RSV与hMPV病例的年龄、症状及医疗使用不同。
A paediatric comparison found differences in age, presentation and healthcare use between RSV and hMPV cases.

highlights.label: Design
text: 三级医院回顾性比较队列。
Retrospective comparative cohort at a tertiary hospital.

highlights.label: Finding
text: RSV病例更常出现细支气管炎和住院，hMPV患儿年龄更大且合并症更常见。
RSV cases more often had bronchiolitis and admission; hMPV cases were older with more comorbidities.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 两病毒纳入时间不同且来自单一中心，比较可能受季节和病例构成影响。
Different inclusion periods and a single centre allow seasonal and case-mix confounding.

brief: 两座城市的儿童哨点监测显示鼻病毒全年流行，但季节性高峰与气象关联不同。
Paediatric sentinel surveillance in two Chinese cities found year-round rhinovirus circulation with differing seasonal and weather associations.

highlights.label: Design
text: 分析2019—2025年流感样疾病儿童的医院监测资料。
Analysis of hospital surveillance in children with influenza-like illness during 2019–2025.

highlights.label: Finding

A rhinovirus–asthma review proposes that inflammation associated with dysregulated cell death may contribute to exacerbations.

Symptoms and illness rates did not improve; the trial stopped early for futility.

highlights.label: Limitation

A small controlled study does not cover all natural-infection settings.

brief: 意大利监测显示呼吸道病毒季节性逐步恢复，而鼻病毒持续全年流行。
Italian surveillance found returning respiratory seasonality while rhinoviruses circulated year-round.

highlights.label: Finding

Influenza and RSV peaked in winter; rhinovirus/enterovirus detection continued year-round.

highlights.label: Limitation

brief: 济宁监测显示，鼻病毒检出随年份与季节变化，需持续更新地方呼吸道病毒资料。
Jining surveillance found year-to-year and seasonal variation in rhinovirus detection.

Australia’s 2025 report supports continued measles and rubella elimination while emphasizing surveillance of imported infections.

Annual public-health surveillance report combining laboratory and epidemiological evidence.

highlights.label: Finding

The report found no evidence of sustained endemic transmission and very low rubella activity.

highlights.label: Limitation

brief: 学校补种可发现漏种儿童，但人员与协调成本较高。
School catch-up vaccination can identify missed children but carries substantial staffing and coordination costs.

text: 赞比亚20所学校试点的政府视角成本分析。
Government-perspective costing of a pilot in 20 Zambian schools.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 3351名筛查儿童中211名未接种儿童完成补种；整合情景可降低成本。
Among 3,351 screened children, 211 previously unvaccinated children received catch-up doses; integration scenarios reduced costs.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 尚需与其他策略比较成本效果。
Comparative cost-effectiveness against other strategies remains untested.

brief: 尼日利亚冲突地区麻疹监测评估认为，简化暴发报告与定向实验室确证可以互补。
A measles evaluation in conflict-affected Nigeria found complementary roles for simplified outbreak reporting and targeted confirmation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 监测项目回顾性评估结合工作人员调查。
Retrospective programme evaluation with staff survey.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 双轨方式在资源受限环境中保留了实用疫情信息。
The combined approach retained useful epidemic information under resource constraints.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 调查回应有限且当地条件特殊，不能直接推广到所有卫生系统。
Limited survey response and a distinctive local context constrain transferability.

brief: 达卡麻疹住院儿童中，未接种疫苗与更多并发症相关。
Among children hospitalized with measles in Dhaka, lack of vaccination was associated with more complications.

highlights.label: Design
text: 四家医院260名儿童的横断面研究。
Cross-sectional study of 260 children in four hospitals.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 调整模型中未接种者的并发症比值较高。
Unvaccinated children had higher adjusted odds of complications.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 住院选择和残余混杂限制对总体疫苗效果的估计。
Hospital selection and residual confounding limit estimates of population vaccine effects.

brief: 孟加拉国2026年麻疹监测显示较大疾病负担及地区差异。
Bangladesh measles surveillance in 2026 showed substantial reported burden and geographic variation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 对官方疫情简报及历史接种覆盖率进行描述分析。
Descriptive analysis of official outbreak bulletins and historical vaccination coverage.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 报告病例与死亡负担明显，作者强调一致的统计时间窗。
Reported cases and deaths were substantial; consistent reporting windows were essential.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 历史汇总接种率不能证明当次暴发的个体因果关系。
Historical aggregate coverage cannot establish individual-level causation in the outbreak.

highlights.label: Finding

A Taizhou case-control study supports overall mumps-vaccine protection, while high coverage makes some subgroup estimates unstable.

Matched case-control study in children.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 接种与较低患病风险相关；两剂期未达统计显著不能解释为两剂无效。

brief: 英格兰资料提示首剂MMR后罕见ITP风险增加，第二剂未见增加。
English records suggest a rare ITP increase after the first MMR dose, with no increase detected after the second.

highlights.label: Design

Self-controlled case series linking hospitalization and vaccination records.

highlights.label: Finding

Estimated attributable risk after dose one was about one per 42,900 doses.

highlights.label: Limitation

brief: 一例接种后眼部炎症报告提供长期随访资料，但不能证明疫苗因果关系。
A post-vaccination ocular inflammation report provides long-term follow-up without establishing vaccine causality.

highlights.label: Design

Case report of one infant with six-year ophthalmic follow-up.

highlights.label: Finding

highlights.label: Limitation

Temporal association and a single case cannot estimate risk or establish causation.

brief: 江苏长期监测显示，两剂MMR政策实施后腮腺炎发病呈持续下降趋势。
Long-term Jiangsu surveillance found declining mumps incidence after introduction of the two-dose MMR policy.

highlights.label: Design

Interrupted time-series analysis of statutory surveillance data.

highlights.label: Finding

Declines involved targeted child age groups, with reductions also observed among adults.

Case report of suspected congenital rubella followed by evaluation for lysosomal disease.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 生化结果支持可能的戈谢病，但未达到确诊。
Biochemical findings supported probable Gaucher disease without definitive confirmation.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 风疹未完全排除，遗传分型及最终死因亦不明确。
Rubella was not fully excluded, and genetic resolution and certified cause of death were unavailable.

brief: 江苏孕妇血清调查提示，年轻出生队列的风疹抗体阳性率较低。
A Jiangsu pregnancy serosurvey found lower rubella antibody positivity in younger birth cohorts.

highlights.label: Design
text: 横断面血清流行病学研究。
Cross-sectional seroepidemiological study.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 研究指出维持儿童接种之外，孕前预防与免疫监测仍值得关注。
The findings highlight preconception prevention and immunity surveillance alongside childhood vaccination.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 抗体阈值和地方样本限制推广，不能直接计算所有孕妇的临床感染风险。
Antibody thresholds and local sampling limit generalisation to clinical infection risk in all pregnant women.

brief: 带状疱疹患者维生素D偏低，但多种分析未支持把这一现象直接解释为疾病的原因。
Vitamin D was lower in hospitalized shingles patients, but the analyses did not support treating that observation as a direct cause of disease.

highlights.label: Design
text: 结合回顾性临床资料、遗传工具分析和独立随访数据。
Combined retrospective clinical, genetic-instrument and independent longitudinal analyses.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 遗传预测的长期维生素D水平与易感性结果接近无关联。
Genetically predicted long-term vitamin D levels showed near-null associations with susceptibility.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 观察到低水平不能证明补充维生素D能治疗带状疱疹。
Low measured levels do not establish that supplementation treats shingles.

brief: 脑脊液检测出VZV序列并不能单独证明神经系统疾病的病因。
VZV sequences in cerebrospinal fluid alone do not establish the cause of neurological disease.

highlights.label: Design
text: 23例患者的单中心回顾性病例系列。
Single-centre retrospective series of 23 patients.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 临床表现多样，部分患者同时检出其他微生物。
Presentations varied and some patients had additional organisms detected.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 未做VZV特异PCR且无对照组，不能估计诊断准确度。
No VZV-specific PCR or comparison group was available to estimate diagnostic accuracy.

brief: HIV感染者带状疱疹疫苗研究的重点正延伸到真实世界效果与可及性。
Zoster vaccination research in people with HIV increasingly needs real-world effectiveness and access evidence.

highlights.label: Design
text: 聚焦HIV人群和亚太实施问题的叙述综述。
Narrative review focused on people with HIV and implementation in Asia-Pacific settings.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 现有资料支持免疫应答与安全性，但成本和服务障碍限制覆盖。
Available evidence supports immune responses and safety, while costs and service barriers constrain coverage.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: HIV特异的长期保护和临床效果证据仍不足。
HIV-specific evidence on durable protection and clinical effectiveness remains limited.

Higher triglyceride–glucose index was associated with poorer pain outcomes after zoster-related neuralgia treatment.

Retrospective analysis of 345 patients receiving pain interventions.

highlights.label: Finding

Higher values were associated with adjusted odds of persistent pain at three months.

highlights.label: Limitation

brief: 前瞻资料未发现COVID-19感染或接种与眼带状疱疹复发显著相关。
Prospective data found no significant association between COVID-19 infection or vaccination and ocular zoster recurrence.

highlights.label: Design
text: ZEDS研究402名受试者的18个月亚组分析。
Eighteen-month subgroup analysis of 402 ZEDS participants.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 感染或接种后眼部复发未显著增加。
Ocular recurrence did not significantly increase after infection or vaccination.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 观察性暴露比较不能排除更小风险或所有人群差异。
Observational exposure comparisons cannot exclude smaller risks or differences in other populations.

brief: 澳大利亚儿童住院数据表明，普及水痘疫苗后水痘及带状疱疹住院负担下降。
Australian hospital data show reduced paediatric varicella and zoster burden after universal varicella vaccination.

highlights.label: Design
text: 跨多年住院记录的政策前后趋势分析。
Long-term before–after analysis of hospitalisation records.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 总体负担降低，但低龄及免疫受损儿童仍需更好的保护。
Burden declined overall, while very young and immunocompromised children remained priorities.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 观察性政策趋势并非随机比较；摘要方法与部分数字显示不完整。
Observational policy trends are not randomised comparisons; portions of the abstract methods and numbers are incomplete.

brief: 西班牙模型估计带状疱疹接种项目具有正向社会投资回报。
A Spanish model estimated positive societal returns from a zoster vaccination programme.

highlights.label: Design
text: 疾病模型结合精算和长期成本收益分析。
Disease modelling combined with actuarial and long-term cost–benefit analysis.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 基础情景的收益成本比为1.21。
The base-case benefit–cost ratio was 1.21.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 长期预测依赖成本、效用货币化和人口假设。
Long-term projections depend on costs, monetized health value and demographic assumptions.

A review of refractory herpes simplex keratitis stresses distinguishing persistent infection, inflammation and neurotrophic disease.

highlights.label: Design

Clinical narrative review.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 治疗反应不佳需要重新评估病因、依从性和耐药，而非默认所有病例均由持续病毒复制导致。
Poor response warrants reassessing disease drivers, adherence and resistance rather than assuming ongoing viral replication in every case.

brief: EBV综述将共感染纳入癌症风险研究框架，并指出潜伏感染仍是治疗的重要难题。
An EBV review considers coinfections in cancer research and identifies latent infection as an unresolved treatment challenge.

highlights.label: Design
text: 整合多病原体相关文献的叙述性综述。
Narrative synthesis of literature involving multiple pathogens.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 文章提出，需要把共感染、免疫状态与长期疾病结局共同纳入研究。
The review argues for studying coinfection, immune status and long-term disease outcomes together.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 综述提出的治疗方向仍属研究议题，不能据此认定已能清除潜伏EBV。
Proposed therapeutic directions remain research questions, not proof that latent EBV can be eradicated clinically.

brief: GFAP星形胶质细胞病患者中，脑脊液EBV检出与更重急性炎症表现相关。
In GFAP astrocytopathy, CSF EBV detection was associated with a more severe acute inflammatory presentation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 回顾性比较观察研究。
Retrospective comparative observational study.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 检出EBV组更常进入重症监护，多数随后功能改善。
The EBV-detected group more often required intensive care, although most later improved functionally.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 检出病毒DNA不等于EBV是病因；检测选择和病情差异可能混杂结果。
Viral DNA detection does not establish EBV causation; test selection and severity may confound comparisons.

brief: EB病毒阳性可提供胃癌分型信息，但不能单独决定免疫治疗。
EBV positivity informs gastric-cancer classification but should not alone determine immunotherapy.

highlights.label: Design
text: 综合诊断、病理和临床证据的叙述性综述。
Narrative review of diagnostic, pathological and clinical evidence.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 免疫治疗反应并不一致，需结合已验证标志物和分期。
Responses vary, requiring established biomarkers and disease stage to be considered.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 部分支持证据来自小型无对照研究，仍需前瞻验证。
Some evidence comes from small uncontrolled studies and needs prospective validation.

brief: EB病毒与多发性硬化的因果研究需要可检验的临床框架。
EBV–multiple sclerosis causality needs a clinically testable framework.

highlights.label: Design
text: 概念性综述提出复杂自身免疫的因果判断框架。
Conceptual review proposing a causality framework for complex autoimmunity.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 强调时间顺序、疾病活动与干预效果之间的证据衔接。
Emphasizes linking temporal precedence, disease activity, and intervention responses.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 这是研究框架，尚非已验证的临床因果模型。
This is a research framework, not a validated clinical causal model.

brief: EBV鼻咽癌综述强调，肿瘤发生涉及病毒状态、宿主易感性与微环境的动态关系。
An EBV nasopharyngeal-cancer review highlights dynamic relationships among viral state, host susceptibility and the tumour environment.

highlights.label: Design
text: 分子病理学研究的叙述性综述。
Narrative review of molecular pathogenesis research.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 新技术揭示肿瘤内部异质性，提示单一静态模型不足以解释疾病。
New technologies reveal intratumour heterogeneity that challenges a single static disease model.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 机制研究整合不能直接预测临床疗效，提出的解释仍需验证。
Synthesised mechanistic evidence cannot directly predict clinical benefit; proposed explanations require validation.

brief: EB病毒与炎症性肠病相关，但现有证据不能确定因果关系。
EBV is associated with inflammatory bowel disease, but causation remains unresolved.

highlights.label: Design
text: 系统检索后纳入45项研究。
Included 45 studies after systematic searching.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 活动性或难治性病例的肠组织更常检出EB病毒。
EBV was detected more often in intestinal tissue from active or refractory cases.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 病情、免疫治疗和检测差异可能混淆关联。
Disease severity, immunosuppression and testing differences may confound associations.

brief: 延迟EB病毒初次感染与1型糖尿病关系仍属于假说。
A relationship between delayed primary EBV infection and type 1 diabetes remains hypothetical.

highlights.label: Design
text: 比较不同地区感染年龄与糖尿病发生情况的综述。
Review comparing infection timing and diabetes occurrence across populations.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 提出感染时间可能参与环境风险差异的解释。
Proposes infection timing as one possible contributor to environmental risk differences.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 群体比较不能证明保护作用，也不支持主动感染。
Population comparisons establish neither protection nor a rationale for intentional infection.

A real-world paediatric transplant and cellular-therapy series reports CMV responses and tolerability with maribavir.

highlights.label: Design

Multicentre retrospective case series.

highlights.label: Finding

Virological responses occurred, alongside non-response, resistance and adverse events.

highlights.label: Limitation

No randomised comparator and frequent combination treatment prevent attribution of independent efficacy.

brief: 儿科重症CMV病例的死亡风险更接近器官功能障碍程度，而非单独病毒载量。
Mortality in paediatric intensive-care CMV cases tracked organ dysfunction more closely than viral load alone.

highlights.label: Design
text: 回顾一所重症监护病房79名CMV感染儿童。
Retrospective study of 79 children with CMV in one intensive-care unit.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 病毒载量对死亡的区分能力较差。
Viral load poorly discriminated mortality outcomes.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 感染与重症并存不能证明CMV直接导致死亡。
Co-occurrence with critical illness does not establish CMV as the cause of death.

brief: 儿童后天CMV感染的影响取决于年龄、免疫状态及社会环境。
Effects of acquired childhood CMV depend on age, immune status, and context.

highlights.label: Design
text: 综述儿童后天CMV的临床与免疫证据。
Review of clinical and immune evidence on acquired childhood CMV.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 危害证据在早产及HIV相关高风险儿童中较强。
Evidence of harm is strongest in preterm and HIV-associated high-risk groups.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 免疫健全儿童资料异质，无法推出统一干预策略。
Heterogeneous evidence in immunocompetent children does not support a uniform intervention strategy.

brief: CMV与肿瘤干细胞综述指出，病毒在癌组织中的存在与作用仍有争议。
A CMV–cancer-stem-cell review stresses that viral presence and significance in tumours remain contested.

highlights.label: Design
text: 批判性叙述综述。
Critical narrative review.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 不同检测研究结果不一致，作者提出需要情境化验证而非认定普遍致癌关系。
Conflicting detection findings call for context-specific validation rather than assuming a universal oncogenic relationship.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 关联尚未确立，不能据此推荐以抗CMV治疗癌症。
The association is unestablished and does not justify anti-CMV cancer treatment.

brief: 移植患者观察队列中，较短与较长马立巴韦疗程结局相近，但不能据此缩短处方。
Observed outcomes were similar with shorter and longer maribavir courses, but this does not justify shortening prescriptions.

highlights.label: Design
text: 三中心61名实体器官移植成人的回顾性队列。
Retrospective three-centre cohort of 61 adult solid-organ transplant recipients.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 两组病毒清除和复发比例相近。
Viral clearance and recurrence proportions were similar between groups.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 疗程分组的基线风险不同且未随机分配。
Baseline risk differed and treatment duration was not randomized.

brief: CMV抗体指标与宫颈排毒的关联可能帮助疫苗终点评估。
Associations between CMV antibody measures and cervical shedding may inform vaccine endpoint research.

highlights.label: Design
text: 142名血清阳性女性的观察研究。
Observational study of 142 seropositive women.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 部分结合抗体与排毒相关，中和抗体未见同样关联。
Some binding-antibody measures correlated with shedding; neutralizing measures did not show the same association.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 关联指标尚未验证为保护或先天感染风险的替代终点。
These associations are not validated surrogates for protection or congenital infection risk.

brief: 急性CMV合并肠道螺旋体病病例展示了直肠炎鉴别诊断中的检测交叉反应问题。
A case of acute CMV with intestinal spirochetosis illustrates diagnostic cross-reactivity in proctitis.

highlights.label: Design
text: 单病例报告与文献综述。
Single case report with literature review.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 免疫染色阳性需要结合血清学与组织形态解释，不能单独判定梅毒。
Positive immunostaining requires serological and histological context rather than independently establishing syphilis.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单例不能估计合并感染频率或比较治疗效果。
One case cannot estimate coinfection frequency or compare treatments.

In a small occupationally exposed adult cohort, all vaccine completers seroconverted to the measured HPV types.

highlights.label: Design

Single-centre prospective immunogenicity study.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 结果补充了较年长男性等研究不足人群的抗体应答资料。
The findings add antibody-response data for understudied adults, including older men.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 完成者较少且存在失访；免疫原性不证明职业传播风险或临床保护。
Few completers and attrition limit inference; immunogenicity proves neither occupational transmission risk nor clinical protection.

brief: 沙特护理学生访谈提示HPV知识、污名和沟通能力仍有教育需求。
Saudi nursing-student interviews identified educational needs involving HPV knowledge, stigma and communication.

highlights.label: Design
text: 36名学生参加六组焦点讨论。
Six focus groups involving 36 students.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 学生报告疫苗安全误解和讨论性健康的困难。
Students described vaccine-safety misconceptions and difficulty discussing sexual health.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单校定性结果不能估计总体比例或证明教学方法有效。
Single-university qualitative findings cannot estimate prevalence or establish teaching effectiveness.

brief: HPV口咽癌预防研究强调提高疫苗覆盖。
HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer prevention research emphasizes vaccine uptake.

highlights.label: Design
text: 检索截至2025年12月的叙述综述。
Narrative review with searches through December 2025.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 疫苗可降低口腔HPV流行，男性及弱势地区覆盖仍不足。
Vaccination lowers oral HPV prevalence, while uptake gaps persist among males and deprived communities.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 降低感染不等于已直接证实全部长期癌症获益。
Reduced infection does not directly establish every projected long-term cancer benefit.

brief: 德国局部B19暴发分析提示，同时存在多条传播谱系，支持持续公共卫生监测。
A regional German B19 outbreak analysis suggests multiple circulating lineages and supports continued public-health surveillance.

highlights.label: Design
text: 基于患者样本的地区暴发观察研究。
Regional observational outbreak study using patient samples.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 观察到不止一个遗传分组；该发现有助于描述暴发的多样性。
More than one genetic group was observed, helping describe outbreak diversity.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 地区样本不能代表全球流行情况；序列差异本身不能证明临床严重程度改变。
Regional sampling is not globally representative; sequence differences alone do not establish altered clinical severity.

brief: 巴西南部B19监测显示全年流行并伴季节差异，支持完善地方监测。
Southern Brazilian B19 surveillance found year-round circulation with seasonal variation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 多年皮疹患者样本的观察性监测。
Multiyear observational surveillance among patients with rash illness.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 资料提示持续地方流行而非仅单次引入。
The data support sustained local circulation rather than only a single introduction.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 就诊与送检偏倚限制对普通人群发病率的推断。
Healthcare and testing selection limit inference about general-population incidence.

brief: 细小病毒B19关节炎可类似自身免疫疾病，诊断需要结合发病时间和病毒学证据。
Parvovirus B19 arthritis can resemble autoimmune disease, requiring timing and virological evidence in diagnosis.

highlights.label: Design
text: 总结临床表现与管理的叙述性综述。
Narrative review of clinical presentation and management.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 作者强调标准化诊断和前瞻随访的研究价值。
The authors emphasize standardized diagnosis and prospective follow-up.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 综述观点不能确定个体患者是否会发展为自身免疫病。
Review-level interpretation cannot predict autoimmune progression in an individual.

brief: B19妊娠风险模型提示提高早期识别可能减少胎儿损失。
B19 pregnancy modeling suggests earlier detection may reduce fetal losses.

highlights.label: Design
text: 基于文献及专家输入的情景模型和决策树。
Scenario and decision-tree models using literature and expert inputs.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 提高检出率的情景预测更少死胎及更多宫内输血。
Higher-detection scenarios predicted fewer stillbirths and more intrauterine transfusions.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 结果取决于感染率、免疫率及处置假设，并非观察到的效果。
Results depend on infection, immunity, and management assumptions, rather than observed intervention effects.

brief: 镰状细胞病患儿B19感染表现因疾病基因型而异，既往羟基脲治疗与输血需求较少相关。
B19 presentations differed by sickle-cell genotype, and hydroxyurea use was associated with less transfusion.

highlights.label: Design
text: 儿童患者回顾性临床资料分析。
Retrospective analysis of paediatric clinical records.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 不同基因型的疼痛、炎症与住院表现不同；用药组同时较常出现中性粒细胞减少。
Pain, inflammatory findings and admission patterns differed by genotype; neutropenia was more frequent in the treated group.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 非随机用药存在混杂，不能将观察关联直接解释为治疗因果效果。
Non-random treatment is confounded and does not establish a causal treatment effect.

brief: 小型B19相关肌肉骨骼炎症队列中，多数患者未升级免疫治疗即缓解。
Most patients in a small B19-related musculoskeletal inflammation cohort improved without escalating disease-modifying therapy.

highlights.label: Design
text: 多中心纳入24名成人的观察研究。
Multicentre observational study enrolling 24 adults.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 21名有随访者中20名达到临床缓解。
Twenty of 21 patients with follow-up achieved clinical remission.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 样本小且来自风湿科转诊人群，不能代表全部感染者。
The small rheumatology-referral sample is not representative of all infections.

brief: 急性B19及EB病毒血症可伴抗核抗体阳性，需结合感染背景解释。
Acute B19 and EBV DNAemia can accompany ANA positivity, requiring infection-aware interpretation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 205名免疫健全患者的回顾性横断面比较。
Retrospective cross-sectional comparison of 205 immunocompetent patients.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 急性B19和EBV组抗核抗体阳性更多，多为低滴度。
ANA positivity was higher in acute B19 and EBV groups, generally at low titers.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 缺少纵向资料，不能判断抗体是否短暂或预测自身免疫病。
Without longitudinal data, persistence and future autoimmune disease cannot be determined.

brief: B19关节病综述提醒，急性对称性多关节炎可模拟类风湿关节炎。
A B19 arthropathy review warns that acute symmetric polyarthritis can resemble rheumatoid arthritis.

highlights.label: Design
text: 以成人证据为主的叙述性综述。
Adult-focused narrative review.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 多数病例自限，但血清学与持续低水平DNA检出可能增加误诊风险。
Most cases resolve, while serology and persistent low-level DNA detection can complicate diagnosis.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 文章提出的诊断框架尚非前瞻验证工具，持续症状仍需个体评估。
The proposed framework is not a prospectively validated tool; persistent symptoms require individual assessment.

Updated UK travel-vaccination methodology illustrates risk assessment using epidemiology while acknowledging data gaps.

highlights.label: Design

Structured review of 2022–2025 hepatitis A and typhoid evidence.

Hepatitis A recommendations changed for 30 countries.

highlights.label: Limitation

Incomplete surveillance and modelling bias limit country-level risk estimates.

US hepatitis surveillance found declining HCV viremia alongside persistent prevention gaps.

highlights.label: Design

Weighted NHANES population analysis covering 2011–2023.

highlights.label: Finding
text: HCV RNA检出下降，HBV相关免疫指标与疫苗覆盖仍需关注。
HCV RNA detection declined, while HBV immunity measures and vaccination coverage remained concerns.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 血清指标不能单独等同临床保护；部分摘要数值被截断。
Serological measures alone do not equal clinical protection; some abstract values are truncated.

brief: 重症儿童甲肝病例在多学科支持及血浆置换后恢复，但无法分离各治疗贡献。
A severe paediatric hepatitis A case recovered after multidisciplinary support and plasma exchange, without isolating treatment contributions.

highlights.label: Design

Single case report.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 描述了肝肾功能及脑病恢复，为进一步研究提供病例线索。
Recovery of organ function and encephalopathy provides a signal for further study.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 无对照且联合治疗，不能证明血浆置换普遍有效或应替代移植评估。
No comparator and concurrent care prevent establishing efficacy or replacing transplant assessment.

brief: 佛罗里达监测发现一批与古巴旅行相关的甲肝病例。
Florida surveillance identified a cluster of hepatitis A cases associated with travel to Cuba.

highlights.label: Design
text: 调查2024年6月至2026年2月的确诊病例。
Investigated confirmed cases from June 2024 to February 2026.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 249例中76例报告近期赴古巴旅行。
Seventy-six of 249 cases reported recent travel to Cuba.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 仅部分患者完成详细问卷，不能直接估计古巴总体发病率。
Only some patients completed detailed questionnaires; Cuban population incidence cannot be estimated directly.

brief: 慢性乙肝小型队列发现，治疗后较高自分泌运动因子水平与后续肝癌发生相关。
A small chronic hepatitis B cohort linked higher post-treatment autotaxin levels with subsequent liver cancer.

highlights.label: Design
text: 单中心回顾性探索研究。
Single-centre retrospective exploratory study.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 该指标可能补充治疗期间残余肝癌风险评估，仍需外部验证。
The marker may inform residual liver-cancer risk assessment during therapy, pending external validation.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 肝癌事件少且阈值来自同一队列，不能直接作为常规临床决策标准。
Few cancer events and a threshold derived within the same cohort limit immediate clinical use.

Gaps in knowledge, attitudes and coverage suggest needs for school-based prevention and services.

A pilot infection-risk model in decompensated HBV cirrhosis showed preliminary discrimination, insufficient for clinical use.

highlights.label: Design

highlights.label: Finding
text: 校正后区分度约0.70，校准估计不精确。

highlights.label: Limitation

brief: 监所肝炎预防需要把筛查、乙肝疫苗和治疗衔接起来。
Prison hepatitis prevention needs linked screening, HBV vaccination, and treatment.

Cross-sectional survey of 693 people in three Italian prisons.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 乙肝易感比例较高，疫苗接受意愿及服务覆盖存在缺口。
HBV susceptibility was common, with gaps in vaccine willingness and service coverage.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 三个机构的横断面资料限制全国推广及因果判断。
Cross-sectional data from three facilities limit national generalization and causal inference.

brief: 匈牙利丙肝共识更新强调及时筛查、确诊和直接抗病毒治疗的可及性。
A Hungarian hepatitis C consensus update emphasises timely diagnosis and access to direct-acting antivirals.

highlights.label: Design
text: 国家共识与管理路径综述。
Review of national consensus and care pathways.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 文章将消除诊疗缺口作为个人获益与公共卫生控制的共同重点。
Closing diagnosis and treatment gaps is framed as important for both individual benefit and public-health control.

highlights.label: Limitation

Recommendations and reimbursement reflect the national context and are not automatically applicable elsewhere.

brief: 土耳其医院丙肝照护链研究发现，抗体阳性后的RNA确证检测是重要流失环节。
A Turkish hospital HCV care-cascade study identified confirmatory RNA testing as a major attrition point.

After an antenatal HCV linkage programme, antiviral prescribing and treatment completion increased.

Before–after health-system quality-improvement study.

HCV positivity declined from 2018 to 2024 among people who inject drugs in selected US cities.

highlights.label: Design

Compared three rounds of behavioural and laboratory surveillance.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 抗体阳性比例由62.4%降至38.5%。
Antibody positivity decreased from 62.4% to 38.5%.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 城市样本不能代表全美，且所提供摘要的结果文本不完整。
Selected cities are not nationally representative and the supplied results text is incomplete.

brief: 丙肝筛查覆盖高并不保证及时开始治疗。
High HCV testing coverage does not guarantee treatment initiation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 马萨诸塞州两个针具服务项目185人的基线分析。
Baseline analysis of 185 participants at two Massachusetts syringe-service programs.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 97%曾接受检测，但阳性者仅41%报告开始治疗。
Ninety-seven percent had been tested, but only 41% of those positive reported starting treatment.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 自报及横断面关联不能证明就医体验的因果作用。
Self-report and cross-sectional associations cannot establish causal effects of care experiences.

A Henan economic model projects long-term health and economic gains from antiviral treatment of existing HCV cases.

highlights.label: Design
text: 真实世界治疗资料结合终身决策模型。
Real-world treatment data combined with a lifetime decision model.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 模型在当地价格与假设下预测净收益，并比较不同方案成本。
The model predicts net benefit and compares regimens under local prices and assumptions.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 避免肝硬化及肝癌数量是模型预测而非已观察事件；经济比较不等于疗效优劣。

An AASLD expert opinion stresses detecting hepatitis D in people with hepatitis B and integrating fibrosis assessment and follow-up.

highlights.label: Design

Targeted literature review with expert consensus.

highlights.label: Finding

The document discusses newer therapies and patient selection, reflecting a shift toward proactive assessment.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 专家意见不是头对头疗效试验；具体使用须核对当地批准状态及完整指南。
Expert opinion is not a head-to-head efficacy trial; use depends on local authorisation and the full guidance.

brief: 丁肝治疗研究正从治疗期间抑制转向停药后持久控制。
Hepatitis D treatment research is shifting from suppression during therapy toward durable control after treatment.

highlights.label: Design

Review of screening and clinical evidence for current and investigational treatments.

highlights.label: Finding

Emphasizes appropriate screening and durability of treatment response.

highlights.label: Limitation

Emerging strategies in a review are not equivalent to approved or proven curative treatments.

brief: 意大利HBsAg阳性队列中，HIV与非HIV人群丁肝抗体流行率趋近。
HDV antibody prevalence converged between HIV and non-HIV groups in Italian HBsAg-positive cohorts.

highlights.label: Design

Comparison of cross-sectional cohort data from two periods.

highlights.label: Finding

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 抗体阳性不等同当前病毒复制，结果受人群构成影响。
Antibody positivity does not equal current viral replication, and cohort composition matters.

A review of rotavirus and birth-dose vaccination found health-system capacity and household access both affect timely uptake.

Scoping review of studies from low- and middle-income countries.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 机构分娩、服务能力及社会经济差异是实施研究的重要主题。
Facility delivery, service capacity and socioeconomic disparities were recurring implementation themes.

brief: 中国多中心资料显示轮状病毒就诊负担下降，但住院并发症和费用仍较突出。
Chinese multicentre data show declining rotavirus burden but persistent inpatient complications and costs.

highlights.label: Design
text: 回顾11中心十年的儿童胃肠炎就诊记录。
Reviewed ten years of paediatric gastroenteritis visits across 11 centres.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 轮状病毒阳性率为15.7%，住院费用高于门诊。
Rotavirus positivity was 15.7%, with higher inpatient than outpatient costs.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 时间趋势不能单独证明疫苗效果，未来费用是模型预测。
Trends alone cannot prove vaccine effects, and future costs are model projections.

brief: 意大利真实世界资料支持轮状病毒全程接种降低住院风险。
Italian real-world data support reduced rotavirus hospitalization after complete vaccination.

highlights.label: Design
text: 5岁以下儿童的医院监测检验阴性病例对照研究。
Hospital-surveillance test-negative case-control study in children under five.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 全程接种调整后保护效果为73.5%，置信区间57.6%—83.4%。
Adjusted effectiveness for complete vaccination was 73.5%, with a 57.6%–83.4% confidence interval.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 观察研究仍可能存在残余混杂及地区推广限制。
Residual confounding and regional generalizability limitations remain.

brief: 澳大利亚2025年轮状病毒监测报告记录较高通知负担，并观察到优势型别。
Australia’s 2025 rotavirus report documents a high notification burden and a predominant genotype.

highlights.label: Design
text: 全国转诊样本及法定通知资料的年度监测报告。
Annual surveillance of referred samples and statutory notifications.

highlights.label: Finding

Outbreak and genotype data can inform vaccination-programme assessment and local responses.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 转诊量与监测强度影响计数；型别占比不能单独证明疫苗失效。
Referral and surveillance intensity affect counts; genotype proportions alone do not establish vaccine failure.

brief: 莫桑比克疫苗引入后，轮状病毒仍是婴儿腹泻的重要病因。
Rotavirus remained an important cause of infant diarrhoea after vaccine introduction in Mozambique.

highlights.label: Design

Combined population surveillance with a pathogen case–control study.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 腹泻病因随年龄变化，其他病原也贡献明显负担。
Aetiology varied by age, with other pathogens contributing substantial burden.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单个农村地区结果不能直接推广至全国。
Findings from one rural district cannot be directly generalized nationally.

Infant gut microbiota were associated with oral rotavirus vaccine response.

highlights.label: Design

Cohort study of infants in Panama, Peru, and the United States.

highlights.label: Finding

Some microbial compositions and higher gut inflammation correlated with weaker vaccine responses.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 相关性尚不能证明改变菌群会提高疫苗保护。
Associations do not establish that changing microbiota improves vaccine protection.

brief: 印度尼西亚质性研究发现，轮状病毒疫苗接受度总体较好，但信息与供应障碍仍存在。
An Indonesian qualitative study found generally favourable rotavirus-vaccine acceptance alongside information and supply barriers.

highlights.label: Design

Interviews and focus groups with parents and religious leaders in three provinces.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 卫生服务信任与社区支持促进接受，偏远地区更需可靠供应和信息。
Trust and community support favoured acceptance; remote settings needed reliable supply and information.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 目的性小样本不能估计全国犹豫比例或证实干预效果。
Purposive small samples cannot estimate national hesitancy or establish intervention effectiveness.

This analysis argues that surveillance bias can distort polio risk assessment and supports broader public-health monitoring.

Analytical paper on surveillance representativeness and risk interpretation.

highlights.label: Finding

Clinical and environmental surveillance can complement one another in detecting otherwise missed circulation.

highlights.label: Limitation

The paper proposes surveillance improvements rather than randomised evidence of disease-prevention benefit.

brief: 尼泊尔婴儿试验支持Sabin灭活脊灰疫苗在所测序贯程序中的免疫原性非劣效。
A Nepalese infant trial supported non-inferior immunogenicity of Sabin IPV in the evaluated sequential schedule.

highlights.label: Design
text: 460名婴儿参加双盲随机非劣效试验。
Double-blind randomized non-inferiority trial enrolling 460 infants.

highlights.label: Finding

Type 2 seroconversion was similar, with comparable safety findings.

highlights.label: Limitation

Immunogenicity endpoints do not directly measure long-term clinical protection or very rare harms.

A perspective argues for centering vaccine-derived polio in eradication endgame planning.

Policy perspective on polio eradication.

The authors’ position is neither a new clinical trial nor a replacement for current global policy.

Review of disease status and prevention progress.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 维持高质量长期免疫项目，并关注部分地区成人病例增加，是主要重点。
Sustaining high-quality immunisation and monitoring adult cases in some regions are priorities.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 综述不是新干预比较，地方政策仍需当地监测和指南支持。
The review is not a new intervention comparison; local policy requires local surveillance and guidance.

brief: 乙脑接种研究提示可及性、认知和医务人员建议共同影响接种。
Japanese encephalitis vaccination research highlights access, awareness and health-worker advice.

highlights.label: Design
text: 系统综述纳入26项知识、态度和行为研究。
Systematic review of 26 knowledge, attitude and behaviour studies.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 费用、时间和疫苗供应是反复出现的障碍。
Cost, time and vaccine availability were recurring barriers.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 研究方法不一致，不能量化所有人群中各因素的因果作用。
Inconsistent methods prevent quantifying causal contributions across populations.

brief: 一例不典型狂犬病报告说明，缺乏经典症状或初次检测阴性并不能排除疾病。
An atypical rabies case illustrates that absent classical symptoms or initially negative tests do not exclude disease.

highlights.label: Design
text: 暴露后预防不完整患者的单病例报告。
Single case report following incomplete post-exposure prophylaxis.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 患者经支持治疗存活但遗留神经功能缺损，凸显及时完整预防和诊断评估的重要性。
The patient survived with neurological deficits, underscoring complete prevention and timely diagnostic assessment.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 罕见存活病例不能证明某治疗具有普遍有效性或改变狂犬病总体预后。
A rare survivor does not establish a generally effective treatment or change the overall prognosis of rabies.

brief: 广东狂犬病长期下降与犬类管理、接种及暴露后预防扩展并行。
Guangdong rabies declines accompanied dog control, vaccination, and expanded post-exposure prevention.

highlights.label: Design
text: 1951—2024年病例趋势的描述及回归分析。
Descriptive and regression analysis of case trends from 1951–2024.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 综合防控实施后降至低流行水平，但尚未消除。
Cases declined to low levels under integrated prevention, without elimination.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 生态趋势不能分离各项措施与经济发展的贡献。
Ecological trends cannot separate intervention effects from economic development.

Open-label randomised equivalence trial in healthy adults.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 两方案常见不良事件相近，抗体结果不能仅以阈值达标替代主要等效终点。
Common adverse events were similar; threshold attainment does not replace the primary equivalence endpoint.

Participants were not bite-exposed patients and some had baseline antibodies, limiting post-exposure generalisation.

brief: 社区药房转诊与狂犬病暴露后接种完成率提高相关。
Community-pharmacy referral was associated with improved completion of post-exposure rabies vaccination.

highlights.label: Design
text: 16家急诊组成的系统开展服务改进研究。
Service-improvement study across a 16-emergency-department system.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 使用社区药房者的完成率高于仅急诊接种者。
Pharmacy users completed vaccination more often than emergency-department-only users.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 患者自行选择服务地点，存在选择偏倚。
Patients selected their service location, allowing selection bias.

brief: 马来西亚犬类接种随访显示抗体指标普遍提高。
Follow-up of vaccinated Malaysian dogs found broadly improved antibody measures.

highlights.label: Design
text: 154只家养犬的配对现场血清资料。
Paired field serology from 154 owned dogs.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 达到预设抗体基准的比例从72.7%升至98.1%。
The proportion meeting the antibody benchmark rose from 72.7% to 98.1%.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 便利抽样、随访缺失及检测上限限制总体免疫率推算。
Convenience sampling, incomplete follow-up, and measurement ceilings limit population-immunity estimates.

brief: 索马里兰社区调查发现埃博拉认知存在缺口，为风险沟通提供地方证据。
A Somaliland community survey identified gaps in Ebola awareness relevant to local risk communication.

highlights.label: Design
text: 社区横断面问卷；详细知识模块仅面向此前听说过埃博拉者。
Community cross-sectional survey; detailed knowledge modules were limited to previously aware respondents.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 受访者普遍支持更多健康教育，近期信息接触与较高知识得分相关。
Respondents supported more education, and recent information exposure was associated with higher knowledge scores.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 意向行为不等于真实暴发应对能力，子组得分不能推广到整个社区。
Intended behaviour is not demonstrated outbreak readiness; subgroup scores do not describe the whole community.

Community mobility information helped adapt public-health responses during a Sudan virus outbreak.

Response assessment using community interviews and participatory mapping in Uganda in 2022.

Adapted surveillance identified cases beyond previously prioritized areas.

highlights.label: Limitation

An Ethiopian Marburg response case study describes linking national guidance with frontline clinical consultation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 利用官方文件和临床记录开展的描述性质性案例研究。
Descriptive qualitative case study using official documents and clinical records.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 固定沟通机制有助于协调决策与资源调配，是作者提出的可借鉴经验。
Regular communication was presented as a potentially transferable approach to coordinating decisions and resources.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 没有对照，不能将存活结局归因于治理模式或研究性治疗。
Without a comparator, survival cannot be attributed to the governance model or investigational treatments.

brief: 埃塞俄比亚马尔堡存活者病例系列描述了重症支持与抗病毒治疗期间的恢复过程。
An Ethiopian Marburg survivor series describes recovery during intensive supportive and antiviral care.

highlights.label: Design
text: 仅纳入存活者的描述性病例系列。
Descriptive case series restricted to survivors.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 报告说明严重病例也可能恢复，但不能区分支持治疗和研究性药物的贡献。
Recovery occurred despite severe illness, without separating supportive-care and investigational-drug contributions.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 存活者选择及无对照使疗效和存活率推断无效。
Survivor selection and no comparator prevent efficacy or survival-rate inference.

brief: 卢旺达马尔堡康复者研究方案关注长期健康与随访照护。
A Rwandan Marburg survivor-study protocol focuses on long-term health and follow-up care.

highlights.label: Design
text: 拟开展前瞻纵向队列研究。
Prospective longitudinal cohort protocol.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 计划整合临床结局与免疫学观察，支持康复者服务。
Plans to integrate clinical and immune observations to support survivor services.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 这是研究方案，尚无长期结局或保护效力结果。
This is a protocol, with no long-term outcome or protective-efficacy results yet.

brief: 马尔堡病准备工作需要更连贯的早期发现与跨地区协调。
Marburg preparedness needs more coherent early detection and regional coordination.

highlights.label: Design
text: 生态、流行病学及卫生系统证据综述。
Review of ecological, epidemiological, and health-system evidence.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 诊断延迟和监测碎片化被指出为主要准备缺口。
Diagnostic delays and fragmented surveillance were identified as major preparedness gaps.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 综述建议尚需用实际防控结局检验。
The recommendations require evaluation against real-world prevention outcomes.

brief: 马尔堡治疗与疫苗综述强调，预临床进展仍需转化为可靠的临床证据和公平可及。
A Marburg therapy and vaccine review stresses translating preclinical progress into reliable clinical evidence and equitable access.

highlights.label: Design
text: 文献计量结合针对性叙述综述。
Bibliometric analysis with targeted narrative review.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 研究重心包括临床评价与流行地区合作，科研产出存在明显地理不平衡。
Priorities include clinical evaluation and endemic-region partnerships amid geographic research imbalance.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 动物研究效果不等于人体获益，候选产品不能视为已批准治疗。
Animal effects do not establish human benefit; candidates are not approved treatments.

brief: 历史马尔堡疫情地区的抗体调查发现少量血清反应，但其含义仍不确定。
An antibody survey in a historical Marburg outbreak area found limited seroreactivity of uncertain meaning.

highlights.label: Design
text: 2023年调查313名康复者、接触者和当地居民。
Surveyed 313 survivors, contacts and local residents in 2023.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 多数相关反应还与其他丝状病毒抗原交叉反应。
Most relevant reactions also cross-reacted with other filovirus antigens.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 交叉反应不能证明近期感染、持续感染或保护性免疫。
Cross-reactivity cannot prove recent infection, persistence or protective immunity.

brief: 尼帕暴发文献综述强调，病例传播贡献并不均匀，公共卫生应对需要及时追踪接触者。
A review of Nipah outbreaks highlights uneven contributions to transmission and the value of timely contact tracing.

highlights.label: Design
text: 系统综述结合历史暴发资料的统计分析。
Systematic review with statistical analysis of historical outbreak data.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 平均水平可能掩盖个别聚集事件，因此不能因总体传播有限而放松监测。
Average patterns can obscure individual clusters, so limited overall spread does not justify reduced vigilance.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 历史病例识别和资料完整性影响估计，不能直接预测未来某次暴发。
Historical case ascertainment and data completeness limit estimates and predictions for a future outbreak.

brief: 尼帕病毒治疗研究仍缺乏确定的人体有效性证据。
Nipah treatment research still lacks established human efficacy evidence.

highlights.label: Design
text: 检索至2026年8月的亚洲尼帕病毒叙述综述。
Narrative review of Asian Nipah literature through August 2026.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 强调支持治疗、感染防控及疫苗和治疗的临床研究。
Emphasizes supportive care, infection prevention, and clinical research on vaccines and treatments.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 动物候选药物证据不能直接转化为患者获益。
Animal candidate-treatment evidence cannot directly establish patient benefit.

brief: 尼帕综述强调，及时诊断、感染防控及一体化健康监测仍是应对核心。
A Nipah review highlights timely diagnosis, infection control and One Health surveillance as central priorities.

highlights.label: Design
text: 临床与流行病学进展叙述综述。
Narrative review of clinical and epidemiological developments.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 诊断有所推进，但治疗选择与临床试验基础仍存在重要缺口。
Diagnostic progress contrasts with persistent treatment and clinical-trial evidence gaps.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 综述提及的候选干预不代表已经证明人体有效或获批。
Discussed candidates are not evidence of established human efficacy or authorisation.

brief: 哥伦比亚LC16m8试验未观察到主要终点病例，因此无法估计对mpox的保护效力。
A Colombian LC16m8 study observed no primary-endpoint cases, leaving efficacy against mpox unestimable.

highlights.label: Design
text: 开放标签随机延迟接种试验结合观察队列。
Open-label randomised delayed-vaccination trial combined with an observational cohort.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 研究提供了有限的安全性随访，但招募远低于计划且没有效力终点事件。
The study adds limited safety follow-up, but recruitment was far below plan and efficacy events were absent.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 零病例不等于完全保护；样本量也不足以排除罕见严重不良事件。
Zero cases do not demonstrate complete protection, and the sample cannot exclude rare serious adverse events.

brief: 猴痘网络错误信息模型目前主要提供方法学演示。
Mpox misinformation modeling currently offers mainly a methodological demonstration.

highlights.label: Design
text: 以一周5787条推文比较两类传播模型。
Comparison of two diffusion models using 5,787 tweets from one week.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 不同模型捕捉快速传播与延迟分享的不同特征。
Models captured different features of rapid spread and delayed sharing.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 绝大部分数据集中一天，不能代表长期或全平台行为。
Most data came from one day, limiting long-term and cross-platform inference.

brief: mpox建模综述指出，解释既往暴发并不等于能够准确预测下一次暴发。
An mpox modelling review distinguishes explaining past outbreaks from accurately predicting future ones.

highlights.label: Design
text: 多类数学模型的叙述性证据综述。
Narrative review of multiple modelling approaches.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 前瞻验证不足、报告延迟及地区差异限制预警可靠性。
Limited prospective validation, reporting delays and geographic differences constrain forecasting reliability.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 提出的预测框架尚需实际验证，不能当作确定的未来疫情预测。
The proposed framework needs validation and is not a definite forecast.

brief: 猴痘疫苗获益风险模型显示结论随当地发病风险变化。
Mpox vaccine benefit–risk modelling shows that conclusions depend on local disease incidence.

highlights.label: Design
text: 综合公开试验、监测和真实世界证据的情景分析。
Scenario analysis combining public trials, surveillance and real-world evidence.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 在基础及较高发病情景下，模型支持更明显的净获益。
The model supported clearer net benefit under baseline and higher-incidence scenarios.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 模型估计不等于个体建议，依赖发病率及安全性资料。
Model estimates are not individual advice and depend on incidence and safety evidence.

brief: 中国单中心猴痘住院资料提示免疫抑制与较长住院相关。
Single-center Chinese mpox data linked immunosuppression with longer hospitalization.

highlights.label: Design
text: 58名患者59次住院的回顾性分析。
Retrospective analysis of 59 admissions involving 58 patients.

highlights.label: Finding
text: HIV合并感染常见，较低CD4与较长住院相关。
HIV coinfection was common, and lower CD4 counts were associated with longer stays.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 样本少且存在缺失，死亡及并发症差异仍不明确。
Small numbers and missing data leave mortality and complication differences uncertain.

brief: 巴西城市边缘黄热病监测提示持续接种和监测的重要性。
Peri-urban Brazilian yellow fever surveillance highlights sustained vaccination and monitoring.

highlights.label: Design
text: 暴发期间及之后的蚊媒现场观察。
Field mosquito observations during and after an outbreak.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 调查提示森林边缘人群仍有暴露风险。
Findings indicate continuing exposure risk near forest edges.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 单一地区的生态观察不能估计个人感染概率。
Ecological observations in one setting cannot estimate individual infection probability.

brief: 多发性硬化患者黄热病接种病例系列未识别意外安全信号，但证据规模很小。
A yellow fever vaccination series in multiple sclerosis found no unexpected safety signal, but the evidence base was small.

highlights.label: Design
text: 单中心回顾性病例系列。
Single-centre retrospective case series.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 报告了接种后复发病例，同时存在治疗中断、既往活动等混杂因素。
Post-vaccination relapses occurred alongside potential confounding from treatment interruption and prior disease activity.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 没有对照且影像随访不完整，不能证明普遍安全或确定复发的因果关系。
No comparator and incomplete imaging follow-up prevent establishing universal safety or causation of relapse.

brief: 慢性肾病成人黄热病疫苗研究发现抗体反应延迟，但后续反应总体较强。
A yellow fever vaccine study in adults with chronic kidney disease found delayed but subsequently strong antibody responses.

highlights.label: Design
text: 开放标签非随机临床免疫原性与安全观察。
Open-label non-randomised clinical immunogenicity and safety study.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 后续随访中多数仍抗体阳性，所记录常见不良事件总体可耐受。
Most remained seropositive on follow-up, with generally tolerated common adverse events.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 样本不足以检出罕见严重风险；抗体反应不能直接证明临床保护。
The sample cannot detect rare serious risks, and antibody responses do not directly establish clinical protection.

brief: 哥伦比亚安第斯地区重症黄热病队列显示显著多器官损伤。
A severe yellow fever cohort in the Colombian Andes showed substantial multiorgan injury.

highlights.label: Design
text: 前瞻观察61名转诊重症监护成人。
Prospective observation of 61 adults in a referral intensive-care unit.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 22名患者死亡，死亡者更常见休克和肾损伤。
Twenty-two patients died; shock and kidney injury were more frequent among non-survivors.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 重症转诊样本不能代表所有黄热病感染的死亡风险。
A critical-care referral sample does not represent mortality risk across all yellow fever infections.

brief: 加纳黄热病暴发调查显示蚊媒风险指标与病毒检出并不等同。
A Ghana yellow fever investigation distinguishes vector-risk indicators from virus detection.

highlights.label: Design
text: 暴发地区家庭及蚊媒现场调查。
Household and mosquito field investigation in an outbreak area.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 环境及蚊媒指标提示防控需求，但样本未检出所测虫媒病毒。
Environmental and vector indicators suggested prevention needs, but sampled mosquitoes tested negative for the assessed arboviruses.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 阴性采样不能排除当地传播，也不能确认具体传播媒介。
Negative sampling neither excludes local transmission nor confirms a specific vector’s role.

brief: 黄热病疫苗系统综述发现长期细胞免疫记忆，但其与临床保护的直接关系仍需研究。
A yellow fever vaccine review found durable cellular memory, while its direct link to clinical protection remains uncertain.

highlights.label: Design
text: 人体研究系统综述与叙述综合。
Systematic review and narrative synthesis of human studies.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 长期T细胞反应可补充抗体研究对免疫持久性的理解。
Long-lasting T-cell responses complement antibody-based understanding of immune durability.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 方法异质、观察设计及外周血检测限制保护相关指标的确立。
Heterogeneous methods, observational designs and blood-based measures limit identification of protection correlates.

brief: 哥伦比亚黄热病再现带来明显住院成本与劳动年龄人口寿命损失。
Yellow fever re-emergence in Colombia brought substantial hospital costs and life-years lost among working-age adults.

highlights.label: Design
text: 对2025年病例开展回顾性成本与疾病负担分析。
Retrospective cost and disease-burden analysis of 2025 cases.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 估计医院直接成本约100万美元。
Estimated direct hospital costs were approximately US$1 million.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 仅计算直接住院费用，不能代表所有社会经济损失。
Direct hospital costs do not capture all socioeconomic losses.

brief: 意大利西尼罗病毒地区暴发研究支持将生态与公共卫生监测结合，理解地方流行变化。
A regional Italian West Nile outbreak study supports combining ecological and public-health monitoring to understand local circulation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 人群与动物监测资料的描述性地区分析。
Descriptive regional analysis of human and animal surveillance data.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 结果支持早期已有流行活动及地方持续传播的解释。
The findings support earlier circulation and local persistence as explanations for observed patterns.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 有限样本的时空推断不能证明所有传播路径或个别病毒变化的功能。
Spatiotemporal inference from limited samples cannot establish every transmission route or the function of individual viral changes.

brief: 欧洲2026年西尼罗病毒监测报告显示报告地区扩大。
European 2026 West Nile surveillance reported geographic expansion.

highlights.label: Design
text: ECDC与EFSA截至2026年10月7日的联合监测报告。
Joint ECDC–EFSA surveillance report through 7 October 2026.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 人病例和动物暴发较此前增加，未提示人体疾病严重程度上升。
Human cases and animal outbreaks increased, without evidence of greater human disease severity.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 季节内报告仍会修订，检出变化也受监测影响。
In-season reporting remains revisable, and detection also depends on surveillance.

brief: 西班牙加的斯联合监测显示，人群WNV暴露证据增加，并发现相关病毒共同流行。
Integrated surveillance in Cádiz found increasing evidence of human WNV exposure and related-virus cocirculation.

highlights.label: Design
text: 不同时期人群血清调查结合环境媒介监测。
Repeated human serosurveys combined with vector surveillance.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 人群抗体与媒介检出互补，支持一体化健康监测。
Human antibodies and vector detections provide complementary support for One Health surveillance.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 抗体反映既往暴露，不等于临床发病；不同年份样本可能存在构成差异。
Antibodies reflect exposure, not clinical disease, and sample composition may differ between years.

brief: 马匹西尼罗疫苗不同接种途径的免疫等效性尚无定论。
Immune equivalence of alternative West Nile vaccination routes in horses remains inconclusive.

highlights.label: Design
text: 17匹健康母马参加随机单盲交叉研究。
Randomized single-blind crossover study of 17 healthy mares.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 均出现抗体升高，但皮下接种局部肿胀更明显。
Antibodies increased, while subcutaneous administration produced more local swelling.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 基线抗体高且未包含目标遗传病马匹，限制推广。
High baseline antibodies and exclusion of the target genetic disorder limit generalization.

brief: 法国环境监测研究在临床预警前发现西尼罗及Usutu病毒信号，提示早期预警潜力。
A French environmental-surveillance study detected West Nile and Usutu signals before clinical alerts, suggesting early-warning potential.

highlights.label: Design
text: 地方前瞻监测与既有临床预警时间比较。
Local surveillance compared with timing of existing clinical alerts.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 环境信号可能补充依赖人和动物症状报告的体系。
Environmental signals may complement systems dependent on symptomatic human and animal reports.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 检出RNA不等于感染性或可预测病例数，多地区前瞻验证仍需要。
RNA detection does not establish infectivity or predicted case counts; prospective multicentre validation is needed.

brief: 游轮相关汉坦病毒调查提示，跨国共享病例资料有助于解释相关病例聚集。
A cruise-associated hantavirus investigation illustrates the value of cross-country data sharing in resolving linked case clusters.

highlights.label: Design
text: 跨国暴发调查，综合病例时间与流行病学资料。
Multinational outbreak investigation integrating case timing and epidemiological data.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 作者认为病例属于紧密相关聚集，没有证据提示出现异常新病毒株。
The authors interpreted the cases as a closely linked cluster, without evidence of an unusual new strain.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 观察性调查仍依赖病例识别和接触史，不能逐一确认所有感染来源。
Observational investigation depends on case ascertainment and contact histories and cannot confirm every infection source.

brief: 汉坦病毒疫苗血清研究发现，对不同流行株的中和反应存在差异。
A hantavirus vaccine serum study found variation in neutralising responses across circulating strains.

highlights.label: Design
text: 患者恢复期与接种者血清的实验室比较研究。
Laboratory comparison of convalescent and vaccinated-person sera.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 结果支持持续评估疫苗与地区流行情况的匹配。
The findings support continued assessment of vaccine matching to regional circulation.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 中和抗体差异不是实际临床保护率，不能直接认定某株疫苗无效。
Neutralisation differences are not clinical protection rates and do not establish vaccine failure against a strain.

brief: 汉坦病毒感染可类似自身免疫病，但类似表现不等于持续自身免疫。
Hantavirus infection can resemble autoimmune disease without establishing persistent autoimmunity.

highlights.label: Design
text: 批判性综述临床表现及感染后免疫现象。
Critical review of clinical manifestations and post-infectious immune phenomena.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 急性感染相关免疫损伤的证据强于持续自身免疫的证据。
Evidence is stronger for acute infection-related immune injury than sustained autoimmunity.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 罕见自身免疫报告多为病例，缺乏系统纵向证据。
Rare autoimmune reports are largely case-based, with limited longitudinal evidence.

brief: 国际邮轮相关汉坦病毒应对展示了跨辖区联系追踪的价值。
An international cruise-associated hantavirus response illustrates coordinated contact follow-up.

highlights.label: Design
text: 2026年暴发及美国相关接触者监测报告。
Report of a 2026 outbreak response and monitoring of US-associated contacts.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 88名受监测接触者完成随访，未发现继发感染。
Eighty-eight monitored contacts completed follow-up without identified secondary infections.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 无继发病例不等同零传播风险，也不能分离单项措施效果。
No detected secondary cases does not mean zero transmission risk or isolate individual intervention effects.

brief: 汉坦病毒诊断荟萃分析认为，血清学证据相对充分，但整体确定性仍低。
A hantavirus diagnostic meta-analysis found relatively stronger serology evidence, with low overall certainty.

highlights.label: Design
text: 诊断准确性系统综述与荟萃分析。
Systematic review and meta-analysis of diagnostic accuracy.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 分子和快速检测可在特定情境发挥作用，结果依赖采样时机与参照标准。
Molecular and rapid tests can serve specific settings; performance depends on timing and reference standards.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 不同病毒、样本和人群限制统一推荐，仍需前瞻验证。
Variation in viruses, specimens and populations limits universal recommendations; prospective validation remains needed.

brief: 肾综合征出血热患者的凝血相关蛋白变化与病情严重程度相关。
Coagulation-related protein changes in HFRS were associated with disease severity.

highlights.label: Design
text: 比较50名患者和8名健康对照，并观察病程变化。
Compared 50 patients with eight healthy controls and examined changes during illness.

highlights.label: Finding
text: 部分指标与血小板、凝血及肾功能异常相关。
Some markers correlated with platelet, coagulation and kidney abnormalities.

highlights.label: Limitation
text: 小型观察研究不能确立机制因果性或靶向治疗有效性。
A small observational study cannot establish causal mechanisms or targeted-treatment efficacy.
